en: A black-and-white postcard image depicting two men dressed in formal suits and top hats, one extremely tall and the other extremely short, standing outside in what appears to be a public park or fairground. The tall man is bending down to hand something to the shorter man, who is standing in front of a small building or kiosk with the sign 'Gottfried Knöbel' above its door. Several onlookers, including children, are visible in the background.
